name: CorpTimer
googleShortDescription: Meeting, workout and everyday timers with custom stages and shared time.
description:
Make time for it with CorpTimer.

MEETINGS
Give every speaker a place in one shared plan. Early finishes pass spare time forward; overruns reduce later budgets. Drag the agenda, see segmented progress and the next turn, use a floating Android clock and review planned versus actual timing.

TRAINING AND FOCUS
Boxing rounds, configurable fitness intervals, Pomodoro focus sessions, classroom visual timers, two-player chess, stopwatch laps, countdowns and New Year.

27 SPECIALTY TIMERS
Kitchen, eggs, tea and coffee; meditation, breathing, brushing and yoga; speeches, debates and exam stations; running, swimming, circuits, climbing, archery and more. Run independent clocks or staged routines. Add favorites and choose the timer that opens first. Read scenario guides and use the included illustrations.

YOUR OWN ROUTINE
During full trial or Pro access, edit stages and durations with rotary controls or a keyboard. Save custom setups, import/export JSON and export CSV results. Add a company logo that stays on your device.

TRIAL AND FREE
Start with full access. The trial ends only after both 10 days and 10 timer starts. Afterward Free includes two starts per UTC day; pause, resume and stage handoffs do not count as new starts. New starts need an internet connection for access checks. Existing running primary timers can continue offline.

OPTIONAL PRO
Pro provides unlimited starts and customization. Google Play purchasing is being prepared in this internal-test build and is not available yet. The payment-enabled release will show the localized annual subscription price and renewal terms before purchase.

Programs and notes stay on your device. Trial/access identifiers and counters are processed by Firebase and Cloudflare. Optional live links publish only the chosen public agenda and countdown; private notes and reports are excluded. Feedback uses an in-app form through Web3Forms. No ads or analytics.

Local alerts require notification permission and follow device settings. Specialty stage and speech alerts can be scheduled locally. Up to 48 upcoming alerts across timers are scheduled; keep long programs open to replenish them. Voice and repeated cues require the app open. Android precise timer alarms require separate system access. Floating mode requires display-over-other-apps permission.
releaseNotes: Reliable board session grants and account changes; full local timer-data backup/restore/reset; native elapsed-time recovery; specialty stage/Speech background alerts with explicit permission and schedule limits; corrected kitchen reset, remote command acknowledgement and long lap histories. Compatible Expo/RN patches. Google Play purchases remain disabled pending store setup and tests.
reviewNotes: This is an internal-test preparation build, not a payment-enabled production release. Native Google Play purchases are disabled. No Stripe checkout is offered inside the app. The anonymous identity initializes for trial/free quota checks; new starts require a connection. Meeting starts with 5-minute Welcome and five participants of 11 minutes each. Test a specialty timer from Timers and read in-app limitations. Floating mode is user-initiated, visible and closable; no recording. Final publisher privacy/support pages and declarations are outstanding.
